question: Should new StepFun standard and Step Plan setups both default to Step 3.7 Flash, reversing the Step 3.5 defaults preserved in the July 9, 2026 catalog merge?
rationale: Model availability is established, but choosing the initial model for two provider products is an intentional setup-policy decision that current code and tests cannot resolve.

options.title: Default both to Step 3.7
options.body: Keep the shared constant and adopt Step 3.7 across all fresh StepFun setup variants after inspectable onboarding proof is added.

options.title: Decide defaults separately
options.body: Split the constants if standard and subscription-backed Step Plan should follow different rollout policy.

options.title: Keep Step 3.5 defaults
options.body: Preserve the recently merged conservative setup behavior while Step 3.7 remains explicitly selectable.

recommendation.title: Default both to Step 3.7
recommendation.body: Keep the shared constant and adopt Step 3.7 across all fresh StepFun setup variants after inspectable onboarding proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: He made the final contract corrections and merged the preserved-default Step 3.7 baseline.
